card.name: Linking words before evening dose times
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, in, the, q) right after 'morning' or a dose amount, where the next word is likely 'evening', 'bedtime' or a late-day time. Found in twice-daily or three-times-daily dosing schedules.

modes.label: 'and' after morning
modes.description: The word 'and' following 'morning' (or 'mid-day,') just before evening or bedtime.

modes.label: 'in the' before evening
modes.description: 'in' or 'the' after a second dose amount, leading to 'evening'.
modes.example: diltiazem), reduce LUPKYNIS daily dosage to 15.8 mg in the morning and 7.9 mg in<< the>> evening.

modes.label: 'q' before interval
modes.description: The letter q in an interval such as q24h after a dose amount.
